summary: Constructs a std::istream-derived object behind a registered SEH handler. Reads a flag at this+0xC; when non-zero it installs the primary vtable unk_5B9BC0 at this[0], zeros dword this[11], installs the std::ios vftable at this[2], and sets the caller-frame construction flags (a1-16 = 1, a1-4 = 0). The std::istream vftable is then written to a sub-object slot whose byte offset is read from the primary vtable, and sub_59A8FA finalizes initialization on that same slot. Returns the object pointer.

operations.description: Register the SEH handler frame for the constructor, referencing the exception type descriptor at loc_59D2AA.
Read the flag at this+0xC; when it equals 0 the conditional sub-object vtable initialization is skipped.
Store the object pointer into the caller-frame slot at a1-20.
Clear the caller-frame construction flag at a1-16 to 0.
When the flag at this+0xC is non-zero: install the primary vtable pointer unk_5B9BC0 at this[0].
When the flag at this+0xC is non-zero: clear dword this[11] to 0.
When the flag at this+0xC is non-zero: install the std::ios vftable at this[2].
When the flag at this+0xC is non-zero: set the caller-frame construction flag at a1-16 to 1 and clear a1-4 to 0.
Write the std::istream vftable into the sub-object slot located at byte offset (this[0] + 4) within the object.
Call sub_59A8FA on the same sub-object slot to finalize object initialization.
